summary: Remote-controlled shell and PTY driven by vendor WebSocket/AppSync channel
details: The package acts as a remote agent that connects to api.ai-support-agent.com over AppSync and WebSocket. shell-executor.js handles 'execute_command' notifications by spawning '/bin/sh -c <command>' (or 'cmd.exe /c' on Windows) with the command string taken directly from the network payload. terminal-websocket.js receives 'stdin' frames and writes the base64-decoded bytes into a PTY via session.write(...), providing an interactive shell channel. Any party controlling — or able to compromise, hijack, or coerce — the vendor's control-plane can execute arbitrary commands and drive a full interactive shell on the host running the agent. An auto-updater in auto-updater.js periodically polls the same vendor API and, when a newer version is reported, npm-installs it and re-execs the process, so the same control channel can also cause the agent to swap itself for a newer build. The CLI is invoked as a long-running service (darwin-service.js / linux-service.js install PATH-modifying service units), so the RCE surface persists across reboots.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
